moment.zh: 2006 年世界杯近乎不可逾越，效力尤文二十余年，四十岁仍在扑救 —— 时间在他面前低头。
moment.en: Near-unbeatable at the 2006 World Cup, two decades at Juventus, still flying at 40 — time bows to him.

quote.zh: 门将，是一支球队最后的尊严。
quote.en: A goalkeeper is a team's last line of dignity.

honors.zh: 世界杯冠军（2006）· 意甲传奇
honors.en: World Cup winner (2006) · Serie A icon
